brief: intro video for our brand mascot, a cheeky robot dog, for kids

context.platform: YouTube Kids and Reels, 16:9 and 9:16, 15 s

concept: A robot dog that can do anything except sit still.
plan_outline: 0. Mascot reference first: a character sheet of the robot dog (round head, one floppy antenna ear, orange and white, flat 3D toy look), kept in NeuralCore
1. MS · low · static · bright playroom · the robot dog pops up from a toy box (3 s, the hook)
2. WS · eye · track · same playroom · it zooms across the floor, skids, spins (4 s)
3. CU · eye · static · same playroom · it tilts its head at camera, the antenna ear flops (3 s)
4. MS · eye · static · same playroom · a child laughs and it jumps into her lap (3 s)
5. End card (page) · the mascot's name in a round friendly face (2 s)
why: Simple, bold shapes and three colours keep a stylised mascot consistent across shots.
Bright high-key light and wide framing: comedy and kids' content live in the whole body and the space.
One child, one interaction; no crowd of kids for the model to merge.
